# Documentation Instructions

- Keep docs action-oriented: objective, steps, expected outcomes, and verification commands.
- Prefer short sections over long narrative paragraphs.
- Include concrete file paths and commands that match the current repository structure.
- If behavior changes, update both architecture notes and quick-start guidance when relevant.
- Call out prerequisites and known limits explicitly.
